audit.whatIsWrong: Every mention of Hallowed Mist (W) inverts what it does. spikes[0] says "don't chase her into her Mist (W) where your autos and abilities miss", spikes[2] says "don't extend fights inside her Mist", and dontsFull[1] is titled "Fight her in the mist" as a DON'T.
audit.why: Riot's own text: "Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist." Standing OUTSIDE is what makes Zac's attacks and Stretching Strikes (Q) fail. Stepping in is the only way to target her at all — and Elastic Slingshot (E) is a self-launch that lands Zac inside the cloud. The current text tells a Zac player to do the exact thing that makes him unable to hit her.
audit.corrected: Hallowed Mist blanks attackers standing outside it. E in and land inside the cloud and she is targetable again.
sources: champ-data/_kits/gwen.json (Riot Data Dragon, ability text for Hallowed Mist)

audit.whatIsWrong: The %HP damage is attributed to Snip Snip! (Q) throughout ("Gwen's %HP magic damage from Q", "her %HP Q"), and Q's centre is never identified as true damage.
audit.why: Riot's text puts the %HP scaling on A Thousand Cuts (P) — "Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health" — and Snip Snip! (Q) "deals true damage to units in the center". Getting this backwards drives the wrong build: the passive is magic (MR helps) and heals her (Grievous Wounds helps), while the Q centre is true damage that no resistance reduces.
audit.corrected: A Thousand Cuts (P) carries the %HP and the healing; the Q centre is true damage that ignores resistances.
sources: champ-data/_kits/gwen.json (Riot Data Dragon, A Thousand Cuts and Snip Snip!)

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advice is "build magic resist early" / "Early Mercs or magic resist to blunt her %HP Q", and anti-heal is never mentioned in the content layer.
audit.why: MR does nothing against the true-damage centre of Snip Snip!, and A Thousand Cuts heals Gwen for a portion of the damage it deals to champions — an extended trade against a tank is exactly where that healing compounds. Grievous Wounds is the item that changes the trade maths; MR alone is a partial answer at best. _missing-interactions.json flags this matchup for both needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds first; MR is secondary and never touches the Q centre.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and whys[4] call Gwen's ultimate "Needle Work".
audit.why: The ability is Needlework, one word, per Data Dragon.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Gwen 6 of 7 stages while Zac holds a 53.1% win rate over 113 games, and the full layer separately gives Gwen 5 of 7 — the two layers do not even agree with each other.
audit.why: Zac's early game is the part the chart most obviously misreads. Unstable Matter (W) is a flat 5s cooldown with no resource cost beyond health, while Snip Snip! costs 40 mana on a 6.5s cooldown at rank 1 out of a small level-2 pool; and at 3 Zac has the whole kit, where Gwen's only outs are a 13s Skip 'n Slash and a 22s Hallowed Mist. Gwen genuinely takes 4-5 (Q reaches 5s and the true-damage centre starts out-pacing blob regen) and 6 (Needlework), which is what the chart should say.
audit.corrected: Skill / Zac / Zac / Gwen / Gwen / Skill / Zac.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers appear anywhere. breakdown.cooldowns says only "matchup-defining — She's safe inside. Fight when down."
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 and Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1. Both are long enough that a Zac player can count them, and Zac's E being a 21-second commit is the single most important restraint in the lane.
audit.corrected: Hallowed Mist 22s at rank 1; your Elastic Slingshot 21s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0] is titled "Build armor vs her AP" but its body reads "That is Gwen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone" — boilerplate that does not match the title, and misgenders Gwen.
audit.why: The reason armour is wrong here is specific and worth stating: Gwen's damage is magic (passive, Q edges, Skip 'n Slash on-hit) plus true (Q centre). Armour reads none of it.
audit.corrected: Her damage is magic and true; armour reads the trade wrong and MR misses her centre.

DERIVED-FLAG WARNING (affects all of Zac, not just this matchup): champ-data/_kits/zac.json flags Elastic Slingshot (E) with "grounding" and "projectile". Both look like regex false positives from build-kit-library.js — the grounding rule matches /grounds?\b/ against Riot's phrase "attaches his arms to the ground", and the projectile rule matches /launches?/ against "launching himself forward". Zac's E is a self-dash, not a projectile, and it knocks up rather than grounds. I did not write any text asserting either. _missing-interactions.json has propagated the bad grounding flag into headlines like "Your Elastic Slingshot (E) shuts off Illaoi's Harsh Lesson (W)" and "...shuts off Jax's Leap Strike (Q), Empower (W)" — those should not be used. Stretching Strikes (Q) is also flagged autoReset, which does not match its Data Dragon description either.
